name: Pacemaker Sensing Threshold
description: Sensitivity of a cardiac pacemaker to intrinsic heart signals. Checks whether the device correctly detects native beats to avoid unnecessary pacing.

elements.name: Intrinsic R-wave Amplitude
elements.description: Amplitude of native ventricular depolarisation signal. Varies with electrode placement and tissue impedance.

elements.name: Programmed Sensing Threshold
elements.description: Programmed sensing threshold ensuring reliable native beat detection

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(V_R) = V_R if V_R >= V_sens, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The programmed sensing threshold guards the R-wave amplitude uncertainty set; amplitudes below 5.0 mV fall outside the consistent detection region.
